_note: Silicon PTC temperature sensor (spreading-resistance type, TO-92 body). 2-terminal: a, b. Engine (bw-board ptc_sensor): R = r25 (1 + alpha (T-25) + beta2 (T-25)^2), r25 2 kOhm, alpha 7.88e-3/K, beta2 1.937e-5/K^2; T is its thermal-model temperature (surroundC: its own surroundings, e.g. fingers or ice water; heatedBy; self-heating rth 400 K/W) else the bench. Reports ohms, celsius.
